name: Iran nuclear programme
summary: IAEA told its Board on 18 Nov it cannot verify most Iranian sites or the 60% stockpile; no strike on nuclear sites
state: IAEA Director General Grossi told the Board of Governors on 18 Nov that the agency cannot carry out essential verification at most of Iran's declared facilities and has lost continuity of knowledge over uranium enriched up to 60%; he called diplomacy imperative (Anadolu). No Board resolution, NPT withdrawal or new strike on a nuclear site was found by 20 Nov, so Watch holds on curtailed inspector access.
for_you: This is a monitoring signal with no direct action for most readers. Developments can move oil prices and affect travel advice across the Gulf; FCDO travel advice is the official guide for British nationals.
rubric_hit: Watch: inspector access curtailed and 60% enriched stock unverified (IAEA, 18 Nov); no strike on nuclear sites

sources.title: Anadolu Agency — Return to diplomacy, negotiations on Iran's nuclear program imperative: UN nuclear watchdog

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
